summary: Compositing and Async Pan/Zoom (APZ), the system behind smooth scrolling and touch gestures, gained safer handling for handed-off pans, pinch gestures, sticky positioning, overscroll, and native scrolling controls. HDR video rendering was improved by preserving luminance metadata for planar YUV and PQ video, including a Wayland fallback when metadata is missing, helping prevent washed-out colors. Several IPC and shutdown checks also make layer and texture communication more robust, alongside visual fixes for Nova popups and window chrome.
